name: VNISH NINJA firmware catalog
dev_fee: transparent share of hashrate, embedded in the firmware image, always visible in the dashboard

aml.name: Amlogic
hints: Sticker or silkscreen marking AML / Amlogic on the control board
Square Amlogic A113D chip near the SD slot
Stock UI System page reports amlogic platform

xil.name: Xilinx
hints: Marking XIL / Zynq on the control board or its sticker
Xilinx Zynq chip (large square BGA) in the board center
Most common board on S19 series and hydro models

cv.name: CVITEK
hints: Marking CV / CVITEK on the sticker or PCB
Common on L9, T21 and newer 2024+ boards

bb.name: BeagleBone
hints: Separate BeagleBone daughter-board plugged into the base board
Found on some S19 88-chip and S19j variants
